propositions: Replace per-criterion recovery fan-out with incremental criterion-level banking at the CompletionAgentStep seam, storing verified criteria in a run-scoped bank keyed by deterministic criterion IDs and resuming recovery with only unbanked remainder criteria.

Scale the primary verification step floor from a flat 480 to a criteria-scaled clamp(8×c, 48, 480) where c is the criterion count, eliminating the artificial budget surplus that feeds the runaway guard and reducing recovery frequency.

Plan successor runs as batched requests over the unbanked remainder under a request budget pool = multiplier × ceil(floor/2), with per-run allocation floor(pool/runs_remaining) and batch-aware shrinking to avoid under-budgeted launches.

Normalize read_file memo caching by path rather than exact (path, line_start, line_end), caching whole-file content once and serving all range reads from cache, to eliminate the measured 77% re-read waste during verification.

Always emit a full-coverage verdict when any criteria are banked, scoring verified criteria from evidence and unverified criteria as explicit met=false placeholders, with a deterministic no-LLM fallback that prevents verdict-less outcomes when the finalizer fails.

Ensure successor preflight validation detects ticket/material/tree stamp mismatches against the bank and fails loud, and apply coverage validation by criterion ID order-insensitive rather than requiring ordered full-list equality.
